changeSet.author: yambo
changeSet.comment: Ensure every issue's ordered_product_id exists in issue_order_product before dropping the column
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO public.issue_order_product (issue_id, order_product_id) SELECT i.id, i.ordered_product_id FROM public.issue i WHERE i.ordered_product_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.issue_order_product iop WHERE iop.issue_id = i.id AND iop.order_product_id = i.ordered_product_id );
